name: pennycrab
description: The crab that counts your pennies: routes subagents to cheaper models, stops runaway ones, keeps the prompt cache warm, and shows it all in a live pane

router.title: Subagent router
router.description: auto: Explore, which only reads and searches, runs on Haiku at low effort, and general-purpose on Sonnet when your session runs on Opus or Fable. explore: Explore on Haiku as in auto, general-purpose keeps your model. prudent: both on Sonnet, from Opus or Fable only. off: subagents inherit your model. Never a model above yours.

budget.title: Subagent budget (USD)
budget.description: The most one subagent may spend before the guard asks it to hand back what it found, then stops it if it keeps going. off: no guard.

keepWarm.title: Keep the prompt cache warm
keepWarm.description: Keeps the main conversation's prompt cache warm while you are away, by a short ping just before it would expire: a ping reads the cache, at a 12th to an 80th of the price of writing it again, by model. auto: as long as the pings of one absence cost at most a quarter of the rewrite they spare, up to 8 hours: about 26 minutes on a 5-minute cache with the 5.5 models, one ping an hour on a subscription's 1-hour cache. A time: that long after your last turn. off: no pings.
